rateLimits.note: Production: 40 transactions a second per user, as Amadeus for Developers' rate-limits guide stated it (archived). The test environment allowed 10 a second, no more than one request every 100 ms: the provider gives that rate in place of this one when it is configured on the test environment. Amadeus counts HTTP requests, the guard counts calls: a search is a Hotel List request and up to one Hotel Search request per 20 hotels, an access token is one more request.

provenance.notes: Amadeus for Developers' Self-Service offer is gone: its developer guides were archived on 2026-07-17 ('[DEPRECATED] The Amadeus for Developers Self-Service offer has been deprecated'), the letter to its users (quoted by PhocusWire, 2026-02-09) said API keys would be disabled on July 17, test.api.amadeus.com no longer resolves, and the terms-of-service address now shows the cookies policy only. Amadeus says its Enterprise Portal and Enterprise APIs remain available, on contract (amadeus.com/en/contact). Production under Self-Service required signing its terms of service: commercial use is a contract. The terms themselves can no longer be read: caching, storage, redistribution, attribution and the data's licence are unknown. Card data in a booking falls under PCI DSS. Rate limits from the archived guide (docs/api-rate-limits.md); the monthly free quotas per API in test were never given as figures there.
